description: Expected grading score ranges across 7 evaluation cases for 3 syllabus templates

exact.pedagogicalRationale: Exact redrawn submission should receive near-perfect or 100% score.

jitter_0.2mm.pedagogicalRationale: 0.2 mm manual drafting jitter is within the 0.5 mm tolerance window and should not incur penalty.

missing_hidden.pedagogicalRationale: Missing a hidden detail line drops recall and overall score by 12% to 30% depending on template edge count.

extra_line.pedagogicalRationale: Drawing spurious extra lines drops precision and overall score by 12% to 28%.

swap_line_type.pedagogicalRationale: Misclassifying line type (e.g. solid outline drawn as dashed) retains geometric recall but loses line-type points.

shifted.pedagogicalRationale: Translating drawing on sheet must be neutralized by XY line alignment so placement is not penalized.

badly_wrong.pedagogicalRationale: Gross geometric divergence or unrecognizable shapes should score under 40%.
